dedupeResult: Repository code search returned no existing canonical match for YardHype Radio, UnityXM Radio or M3 Radio by official platform name, route, domain or published submission address before creation. YardHype's fan-chart and paid-promotion pages, UnityXM's request/suggest interfaces and third-party directory contacts, and M3's Live365 player and social profiles were retained as evidence or boundaries rather than duplicated as separate opportunities.
emailVerificationLevel: m3newmusic@yahoo.com was verified through first-party publication, syntax and explicit submission purpose, but uses a consumer-domain mailbox and is not domain-aligned. No first-party public submission email was identified for YardHype or UnityXM. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: YardHype exposes a first-party MP3/M4A/WAV plus optional artwork form with a non-exclusive promotional-airplay licence and fan-voting path. UnityXM publishes strict release, clean-content, genre, artwork and audio requirements, then links to an external DISCO upload inbox that could not be passively inspected. M3 uses an official email route. No visible mandatory payment or login was observed on the first-party pages; hidden or external-provider controls remain unverified.
safety: All three opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no form field was filled, no audio or artwork was uploaded, no licence or consent was accepted, no vote was cast, no login was attempted, no CAPTCHA or anti-spam control was bypassed and no payment or submission action was completed.
